people.name: Ammizabad
people.line: Son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men

people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Son of Jehoiada, a mighty warrior and loyal supporter of David and Solomon.

translations.web: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty: and of his division was Ammizabad his son.
translations.bsb: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
translations.kjv: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
translations.asv: This is that Benaiah, who was the mighty man of the thirty, and over the thirty: and of his course was Ammizabad his son.
